spec: §3 + §14 — RFC 7748 (X25519) reference vectors (ECDH agreement for the Monocypher-C harness, T9)
description: RFC 7748 section 5.2 scalar-multiplication vectors, section 6.1 Alice/Bob Diffie-Hellman, and the section 5.2 iterated test (1 and 1000 iterations from k = u = 9). Scalars are RAW (clamped by the implementation at point of use, RFC 7748 section 5). id111 reaches arbitrary-scalar X25519 through Keyset::ecdh on a 64B keyset whose Ed25519 half is the companion seed below.
provenance: Lifted from keyset.rs::rfc7748_vector_and_agreement (section 6.1) plus the section 5.2 vectors; every value re-asserted at generation time through Keyset::ecdh().
